purpose: Which skins actually DRAW a social dock, and by which component. The Social Dock settings are site-wide and offered on every skin, but only the skins listed here render anything, so on the others an owner can save links and see nothing. SS-1555 places the dock one skin at a time; this records where that has got to, so a skin LOSING its dock is a failure and the outstanding count is a number rather than a feeling.

components.crop-circles: the older shared navigation component that also draws social links
